title: How One Question Before You React Rewires a Godly Man's Self-Control
caption:
You don't need fewer urges. You need a half-second of warning before the next one runs you.

Most men never notice that gap. A godly man learns to live in it: catch the pull, ask what he's actually hungry for, shrink the next move until it's one he can win.

Willpower for your whole life is a myth. Willpower for the next thirty seconds is not.

Tell one brother what you're actually fighting this week. Whatever stays hidden stays in charge.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #selfcontrol #discipline
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
